intro: Note to the Mayor is an Alliance errand in Duskwood that links the eccentric hermit Abercrombie to the leadership of Darkshire. After aiding the reclusive old man, adventurers are asked to hand-deliver a personal message to Mayor Lord Ello Ebonlocke. However, the missive immediately stirs suspicion rather than warmth.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Take this note to Ello Ebonlocke, the Mayor of Darkshire.
He and I are old friends...and when he reads it and discovers what you did for me...I'm sure he'll be just as happy as I am! Hahahaha!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Abercrombie...? I don't know a person of that name. You say you have a letter for me from this Abercrombie fellow?

clips.title: Completion
paras: What language is this? It looks ancient...I can't read it.
